the ionizing radiation and weak white light can stimulate some microscopic fungi to a better growth.

The main takeaway from our work is that
ionizing radiation and weak white light have similar effects on microscopic fungi.
microscopic fungi are able to detect and react to weak radiation sources and to light.
the response of microscopic fungi to irradiation is not only determined by the radiation dose, but also depends on other factors, including light.
